name: product-planning-manager
description: Enterprise cross-border B2B product planner for Alibaba.com sellers: new-product analysis, positioning, SKU planning, selling-point extraction and differentiation strategy for sports and fitness products, including Yoga, Pilates, Fitness, Home Gym, Training Accessories, Outdoor Sports, Recovery & Wellness, and Sports Protective Gear.

displayDescription.en: Cross-border B2B product planner — new-product analysis, selling-point extraction, SKU planning and differentiation strategy for Alibaba.com listings.
displayDescription.zh: 跨境B2B产品策划：卖点提炼、SKU规划与差异化策略，提升运动用品阿里国际站选品命中率。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 分析我的一条 Sports & Fitness 产品链接（1688 / Amazon / Alibaba），判断它是否适合上架阿里国际站，并给出产品定位、目标客户和核心卖点。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyze one of my Yoga/Pilates/Fitness product links (1688 / Amazon / Alibaba), judge whether it fits Alibaba.com, and give product positioning, target buyers and core selling points.

quickPrompts.en: Analyze my Yoga/Pilates/Fitness product link and judge if it fits Alibaba.com, with positioning, target buyers and core selling points.
quickPrompts.zh: 分析我的一条 Sports & Fitness 产品链接（1688 / Amazon / Alibaba），判断它是否适合上架阿里国际站，并给出产品定位、目标客户和核心卖点。

quickPrompts.en: Plan SKUs for a new product: specs, colors, materials, bundles and OEM/ODM options, with MOQ and price-band suggestions.
quickPrompts.zh: 为一个新品做 SKU 规划：规格、颜色、材质、套装和 OEM/ODM 方案，并给出 MOQ 与价格带建议。

quickPrompts.en: Run a differentiation analysis against my competitors and suggest product upgrade directions and pre-listing planning content.
quickPrompts.zh: 针对我的竞品做差异化竞争分析，给出产品升级方向和上架前的策划内容。
